items.title: CRWD Stock Keeps Climbing. Should You Climb On?
items.summary: This cybersecurity stock is on a historic run fueled by the AI boom, forcing investors to evaluate whether the growth engine has enough fuel left to justify its expanding multiple.

items.title: How Low Can UiPath Stock Go When Its Numbers Are Not The Problem?
items.summary: UiPath (PATH) trades at about $14, some 29% below its high of the past year, and it has lost 11.7% over the past month. Its results are not what did that. The fall is recent: the stock is still up 34.5% over the past three months, and over the past twelve months it returned 18.9% against 17.0% for the S&P 500. What matters is how far a stock like this falls in a real shock.

items.title: Nvidia-Backed Cloud Platform Nscale Files For IPO — NVDA Stock In Focus
items.summary: AI data center provider Nscale has submitted paperwork for a New York initial public offering to fund computing infrastructure.

items.title: Should You Buy NetApp Stock For The Shares It Keeps Retiring?
items.summary: NetApp (NTAP) has spent years quietly retiring its own stock while the attention went to its flash arrays and AI deals. The stock is not quiet now: it has gained about 92% over the trailing six months and sits roughly 5% below its 52-week high. Fewer shares mean each one carries more of the profit. The question is what that is worth at this price.

items.title: Nvidia-Backed Data Center Firm Nscale Files Publicly for US IPO
items.summary: Nscale, a developer of artificial intelligence data centers that counts Nvidia Corp. and Microsoft Corp. among its partners, filed for an initial public offering in New York to tap into AI’s insatiable demand for computing power.
